minuteZero.what: The incident commander requests the first evacuation order inside Paradise: the east side of Pentz Rd (Zones 3, 8, 14 and Lower Pentz).
minuteZero.why: It is the first order (not warning) that covers Paradise households, so it is when a coordinator would start calling. The first fire in Paradise was reported 3 minutes later.

events.what: PG&E's grid control center records an interruption on the Caribou-Palermo 115 kV line near Pulga; the fire starts there.
First 911 call reports a fire in the Feather River Canyon near Camp Creek Rd and Poe Dam on Highway 70.
CAL FIRE's official start time, Pulga Rd at Camp Creek Rd near Jarbo Gap.
Second ignition near Rim Rd and Concow Rd (first fire data point in the Concow zone).
Evacuation order for Pulga.
Evacuation warning for Concow.
First structures burning in Concow, 5 km from the origin.
First evacuation warning for Paradise, for Pentz Rd (Zones 3, 8, 14 and Lower Pentz).
Evacuation order for Concow.
ECC takes a call at Drayer Dr and Pentz Rd reporting three spot fires on the Paradise side of the canyon.
First evacuation order in Paradise: east side of Pentz Rd (Zones 3, 8, 14, Lower Pentz). Minute 0.
First 911 report of fire in Paradise, on Lowry Ln off Pentz Rd.
First spot fires arrive in Paradise, 12 km from the origin.
BCSO sends CodeRED for the Pentz Rd zones.
IC extends orders to Zones 2, 7, 13 and Morgan Ridge; everything west becomes a warning.
ECC calls the Sheriff's Office with immediate mandatory evacuations for all of Paradise (NIST TN 2252 places the same step at 08:03).
Butte ECC tells Paradise PD that all of Paradise is under mandatory evacuation; from here 911 operators and officers tell every zone to leave.
Feather River Hospital impacted by fire; its full evacuation had been ordered at 08:07.
Main fire front reaches Pentz Rd between Apple View Way and Lowry Ln; 30 spot fires had been identified in Paradise by then, reaching 3.4 km into town.
Spot fire ignites in Honey Run Canyon on the west side of Paradise, 6.3 km from Lowry Ln.
IC names Paradise Zones 1, 4, 9, 5, 11, Lower Clark and most of Magalia for orders (Paradise had effectively been under orders since 08:03).
Fire is impacting Pentz, Bille, Pearson and Clark Roads at once, with civilians stuck in traffic and trapped in vehicles.
Edgewood Ln overcome by fire; five of the victims found in or beside vehicles were on Edgewood Ln.
Fire pushing south down Berkshire Ave and approaching Bille Rd and Skyway from several directions; structures burning south and east of Skyway near Almond St and Fir St.
Fire well established through most of Paradise and impacting downtown; 10 to 15 structures burning at the south end of Andover Dr and on Adrian Dr.
Heavy fire on the west side of Skyway between Black Olive Dr and Jewell Rd, threatening Town Hall.
Sunset. In Paradise structures keep burning, but the run has moved on to the foothills toward Highway 99; the scenario's last front is 17:00.
Fire 100% contained at 153,336 acres after 17 days.

conflicts: Ignition: 06:15 (line fault, DA), 06:25 (first 911 call), 06:29 (Green Sheet), 06:33 (CAL FIRE official start).
Deaths: 85 (CAL FIRE, Sheriff, NIST) against 84 direct deaths in the DA report, which counts only deaths within the footprint on 8 November or after medical evacuation.

Whole-town order: 08:02 (ECC log) or 08:03 (NIST TN 2252) against 09:17 (LA Times). CapRadio reports Zones 1, 11 and 12 stayed under warning until after 16:00, but the Sheriff tweeted Zones 11 and 12 at 08:55, and CodeRED logs show Zones 4, 9 and 10 were never sent a CodeRED message.
